patient_partition: original train/val/test unchanged; inner folds use original train PATNO only
preprocessing: separately fitted inside each training fold
baseline_correction: same aligned targets and raw residual as first round

selection.bilstm: One whole multitask checkpoint/configuration. Challenger minimizes the mean of three baseline-normalized losses: MAE12, MAE24, and 1-mean(ROC-AUC, AP).
selection.retention: Keep corrected baseline unless challenger improves both regression MAEs, class ROC-AUC/AP mean and balanced accuracy on both internal fold means and original validation seed means.
selection.xgboost: Separate challenger per task from mean inner-fold MAE or ROC-AUC/AP with nondecreasing balanced accuracy. Keep baseline unless also improved on original validation seed mean.
selection.test: No test evaluation, no new test score. Internal CV and original validation are development estimates, not independent confirmation.
